facts.text: On a mine site, a light vehicle is an ordinary pickup, four-wheel-drive or van used by supervisors, maintenance crews and visitors to move among heavy machines.
facts.quote: On a mine site, a light vehicle is an ordinary pickup, four-wheel-drive or van used by supervisors, maintenance crews and visitors to move among the heavy machines.

facts.text: Mine-site light vehicles share haul roads with trucks that weigh roughly a hundred times more.
facts.quote: It shares haul roads with trucks that weigh a hundred times more

facts.text: Mine sites fit light vehicles with tall flags, flashing strobe lights and radios, and set rules for parking and approaching heavy machines.
facts.quote: sites fit it with tall flags, flashing strobe lights and radios, and set rules for where it may park and how it may approach a machine.

facts.text: The size mismatch between light vehicles and heavy machines makes light vehicles the most common victims in the deadliest surface-mine collisions.
facts.quote: The size mismatch makes light vehicles the most common victims in the deadliest surface-mine collisions.

facts.text: Five of the 13 US haul-truck collision deaths from 2005 to 2021 involved light vehicles.
facts.quote: Five of the 13 US haul-truck collision deaths from 2005 to 2021 involved light vehicles

facts.text: An earlier analysis of surface-mine collisions found that victims were primarily light vehicle occupants.
facts.quote: an earlier analysis found victims were "primarily light vehicle occupants."

facts.text: Two collision cases involved a truck driving over a parked pickup whose strobe light was switched off.
facts.quote: Two cases involved a truck driving over a parked pickup whose strobe light was switched off

facts.text: In one of the two cases involving a truck driving over a parked pickup with its strobe light switched off, the pickup was momentarily hidden by the truck's cab pillar.
facts.quote: in one, the pickup was momentarily hidden by the truck's cab pillar [Chapter 4].

facts.text: In New South Wales, a light vehicle entering a tip-head area was struck by a reversing dozer.
facts.quote: In New South Wales a light vehicle entering a tip-head area was struck by a reversing dozer [Chapter 4].

facts.text: The booklet ranks a haul truck crushing a light vehicle in front of the truck as the number-one harm scenario.
facts.quote: The booklet ranks a haul truck crushing a light vehicle in front of it as the number-one harm scenario [Chapter 4].

facts.text: The collision mitigation system must detect a car-sized object in front of a tall truck, often while the truck is stationary and about to move.
facts.quote: The system must see a car-sized object in front of a tall truck, often while the truck is stationary and about to move

facts.text: A time-to-collision calculation gives no answer when a truck is stationary and about to move toward a car-sized object in front of the truck.
facts.quote: while the truck is stationary and about to move, which is the situation where a time-to-collision calculation gives no answer [Chapter 8].
